title: The Ouroboros Goodstein Principle
summary: In arXiv:2508.14768, a variant of Goodstein's original process was recently introduced which, given a set $B\subseteq \mathbb{N}$ of bases, writes each $n\in\mathbb{N}$ in $B$-normal form, namely $n=b^ea+r$, where $b\in B$ the greatest base below $n$. The numbers $e$ and $r$ are then recursively written in $B$-normal form, and finally each base of $B$ is replaced by a corresponding base of some other set $C\subseteq \mathbb{N}$.
